comparison.objective: Seat a robot-controller add-on board onto two rows of header pins without bending them; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual PCB leveling, simultaneous multi-pin alignment and force-limited seating versus hex-key/collar manipulation and iterative dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Board fully and evenly seated with all pins straight and no damage versus repeatable safe carriage stops with setting retention. Candidate thresholds for rebound, overload and drift are incomplete.
comparison.reason: Both support robot hardware, but multi-pin electronics insertion tests a clearly different ability.
